messages:
Alice: handing off primary to @Ben. Ongoing pager since ~2234566900, impact: elevated 5xxs for embeddings-svc in eu-west; some requests timing out. Current mitigations: switched model to quantized-2, reduced batch window, routed ~20% traffic to fallback-embed-1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-503
incident-bot: [PAGE] severity=P1 service=embeddings-svc region=eu-west count=4294 last=2026-03-15T10:05:00Z
Ben: taking primary. Confirmed @Alice — got context. Who's secondary?
Alice: @Diego is secondary today. Quick checklist I left: 
- keep routing at 80/20 for now
- don't rollback rollout until latency <200ms for at least 1 hour
- if error-rate >10% trigger failover to dedicated pool (see runbook thresholds)
Cara: FYI customer impact: AcmeCorp and NovaMaps reported ingest errors earlier; Support tickets created.
Diego: filed INF-1234 (support) and pinged accounts. JIRA: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-1234
Ben: running the KV-cache flush per runbook now:
```bash
kubectl exec -n prod embeddings-cache-0 -- /bin/sh -c "rm -rf /cache/kv_* && supervisorctl restart embeddings"
```
incident-bot: [ACTION] cache flush started by Ben at 2026-03-15T10:12:05Z
Alice: note on traces: observed trace 0x7a1b... token stalls around step 4. If KV TTLs are >5m consider lowering to reduce thundering herd.
Ben: applying cache-eviction change -> setting eviction to 120s, updating configmap and rolling restart now.
Diego: monitoring tickets and latency dashboards; will open a bridge if SLA breaches continue past the 30m window.
Alice: post-handoff followups I already filed: 
- INF-1235: add canary route test for fallback-embed-1 (assigned Cara)
- INF-1236: update runbook to include quantized-2 rollback + rollback safety checks (assigned Ben)
- INF-1237: schedule retro + postmortem (invite pending)
Ben: Retrospective scheduled for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC, invite sent to #eng-oncall and #product (Zoom link added to calendar).
Cara: ACK, I'll own INF-1235 and add test vectors and CI job notes.
Ben: I'm primary now; @Diego you'll be secondary until 11:30 UTC. I'll stay reachable.
Alice: handing off fully — thanks. If anything escalates page @ben directly or use /page oncall.
incident-bot: [CLOSE] page acknowledged by Ben at 2026-03-15T10:22:45Z
